title: Kuromanta pyramid: documented red granite chambers and GPR scans

tellings.quote: >> Which is um it is a legitimate archaeologically documented man-made pyramid that has internal red granite reaction chambers. They GPR scanned it.

plain: Kuromanta, a hill in Akita, Japan, is said to be a real man-made pyramid, documented by archaeologists, with red granite chambers inside that were found with ground-penetrating radar, a tool that maps what lies under the surface. Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who says he has seen the site, tells it and names someone called Suzuki in connection with it. He calls the chambers reaction chambers, as part of his idea that pyramids were built as machines.
